messages:
alex: Heads-up — dashboard shows weird "coverage" NaN for the new quantized t5-small-q4 run. Anyone else?
lara: yep saw it in /evals -> scorecards diff. Hover tooltip just says "—" which is confusing.
sam: CI failed too: threshold check returned non-zero exit because diff comparator choked on NaN.
ci-bot: CI pipeline: eval-checker job failed: exit code 2. Error: "ComparisonError: NaN encountered".
rachel: likely runner produced empty sample set after quantize step. I saw logs: "selected_examples: 0".
alex: log snippet:
```
runner> selected_examples: 0
runner> shard 3: input_batch_size mismatch, dropped 128 examples
```
lara: ah that's the batching bug we've seen — batching config isn't compatible with tokenized lengths after q4 quantization fallback.
sam: quick workaround in dashboard: treat NaN as "insufficient_coverage" and color gray, but CI comparator should not crash.
devex-bot: Proposal: change comparator to:
```
if np.isnan(metric):
    return "insufficient_coverage"
else:
    return compare(metric, baseline)
```
rachel: For UX, tooltip should explain cause: "Insufficient eval coverage — runner selected 0 examples after tokenization. See run id: run_1783..."
alex: Agree. Also add link to run logs in tooltip and a CTA to replay with reduced batch_size.
lara: For release: small fix in eval-runner to avoid dropping all examples. Patch:
```
# in runner/selection.py
if batch_size > len(tokenized_inputs):
    batch_size = max(1, len(tokenized_inputs))
```
sam: I'll file a minimal PR for comparator + dashboard tooltip copy. Can someone add the exploratory test in CI?
alex: @rachel can you own the runner patch test?
rachel: on it. I'll add a unit that simulates variable-length tokenization and ensures selected_examples > 0.
ci-bot: Added to CI queue: eval-runner-unit (queued).
lara: Also let's update scorecard export v1 to include "coverage_reason" field so exporters can show message.
sam: good call. That avoids having UI infer cause heuristically.
devex-bot: Note: downstream alert rule "eval-regression" currently triggers on any comparator non-zero. We'll relax it to ignore "insufficient_coverage" for now.
alex: timeline?
rachel: I'll have tests + fix by EOD tomorrow, dashboard PR from Sam/Lara after that. Hotfix target for next deploy.
lara: UX copy suggestion: "Insufficient coverage — tokenization or batching dropped all examples. Click to view run logs or rerun with smaller batch."
alex: thanks — capturing this in ticket ENG-ML-5123. :spiral_note_pad: 
sam: cool. I'll add a temp fallback so the dashboard doesn't mark this as a regression.
alex: closing loop — please drop links here when PRs are up.
ci-bot: run_1783456789 logs: https://ci.redwood/run/1783456789
rachel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/249 (tests added)
sam: UI PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1321 (tooltip + gray state)
lara: thanks team :thumbsup: 
alex: done — added release notes line for the hotfix.
